title: Flux Observer
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Sensorless Estimators/Flux_Observer.md
text: Compute electrical position, magnetic flux, and electrical torque of rotor, 6 inputs, 3 outputs, {Block output} sets Block output options Position; {Motor selection} sets the type of motor, {Support 16-bit fixedpoint datatype} sets the support the data type of 16-bit, {Input unit} sets the unit of voltage and current inputs, {Base voltage (V)} sets the nominal voltage corresponding to one, {Base current (A)} sets the nominal current corresponding to one, {Pole pairs} sets the number of pole pairs available in motor, {Stator resistance (ohm)} sets the stator winding resistance, {Stator d-axis inductance (H)} sets the stator winding inductance along d -axis, {Stator leakage inductance (H)} sets the leakage inductance of stator winding, {Rotor leakage inductance (H)} sets the leakage inductance of rotor winding, {Magnetizing inductance (H)} sets the magnetizing inductance of induction motor, {Cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the cutoff frequency of internal highpass, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the interval between consecutive block executions, {Use input port for computed parameters (run-time motor swap)} sets the option to enable input port to accept computed, {Position unit} sets the unit of electrical position, {Position datatype} sets the data type of electrical position output, {Flux unit} sets the unit of magnetic flux, {Per unit flux (Wb)} sets the flux corresponding to one per-unit, {Flux datatype} sets the data type of magnetic flux, {Torque unit} sets the unit of electrical torque, {Per unit torque (Nm)} sets the torque corresponding to one per-unit and {Torque datatype} sets the data type of electrical torque output. Values come from the instance.
